value.rationale: Unlike routine group-order recovery, complete endomorphism-monoid rank and von Neumann regularity profiles expose an intrinsic obstruction to homomorphic generalized inverses. Canonical three-dimensional Leibniz examples exhibit an exact rank-two gap, radically different idempotent counts, and distinct limiting regular proportions (one-third versus one), providing natural structural invariants for endomorphism-monoid comparison.
